thi-ap30:1.1: samattaṃ.* [30.Yasodharā-pamukhāni aṭṭhārasabhikkhunī sahassāni.] Aṭṭhārasasahassāni bhikkhunī Sakyasambhavā / Yasodharī-pamukhāni sambuddhaṃ upasaṅkamuṃ. // //
thi-ap30:2.1: Yasodharīya-sahassāni sabbā honti mahiddhikā / vandanti munino pāde ārocenti yathābalaṃ: // //
thi-ap30:3.1: Jātikhīṇajarā vyādhi maraṇañ ca mahāmuni / anāsavaṃ padaṃ santaṃ amataṃ yāma nāyaka. // //
thi-ap30:4.1: Khalitañ ce pure atthi sabbāsam pi mahāmuni / aparādhaṃ pajānanti; khama amhaṃ vināyaka. // //
thi-ap30:5.1: Iddhiñ cāpi nidassetha mama sāsanakārike / parisānañ ca sabbāsaṃ kaṅkhaṃ chindatha yāvatā // //
thi-ap30:6.1: Yasodharī mahāvīra manāpā piyadassanā / sabbā tuyhaṃ mahāvīra agāramhi pajāpatī. // //
thi-ap30:7.1: *Thīnaṃ* satasahassānaṃ navutīnañ chaḷ-uttariṃ / agāre te mayaṃ vīra pāmokkhā sabba-issarā. // //
thi-ap30:8.1: Rūpācāraguṇūpetā yobbanaṭṭhā piyaṃvadā / sabbā no apacāyanti devatā viya mānusā. // //
thi-ap30:9.1: Aṭṭhārasasahassāni sabbā Sākiyasambhavā / Yasovatī sahassāni pāmokkhā issarā tadā. // //
thi-ap30:10.1: Kāmadhātuṃ atikkantā saṇṭhitā rūpadhātuyā / rūpena sadisā n' atthi sahassānaṃ mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap30:11.1: Sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā iddhiṃ dassesu satthuno / nekā nānāvidhākārā mahā-iddhiṃ vidassayuṃ. // //
thi-ap30:12.1: Cakkavālaṃ samaṃ kāyaṃ sīsaṃ uttarato kuru / ubho pakkhā duve dīpā jambudīpaṃ sarīrato. // //
thi-ap30:13.1: Dakkhiṇañ ca saraṃ piñjaṃ nānāsakhā tu pattakā / candañ ca suriyañ c' akkhi Merū pabbatato sikhaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:14.1: Cakkavālagirituṇḍaṃ jamburukkhaṃ samūlakaṃ / vījamānaṃ upāgantvā vandanti lokanāyakaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:15.1: Hatthivaṇṇaṃ tath' ev' assaṃ pabbataṃ jalajaṃ tathā / candañ ca suriyaṃ Meruṃ Sakkavaṇṇañ ca dassayuṃ // //
thi-ap30:16.1: Yasovaṇṇā mayaṃ vīra pāde vandāma cakkhuma / tava vīra 'ppa*bhāve*na nippannā naranāyakā. // //
thi-ap30:17.1: Iddhīsu ca vasī homa dibbāya sotadhātuyā / cetopariyañāṇassa vasī homa mahāmune. // //
thi-ap30:18.1: Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāma dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ / sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
thi-ap30:19.1: Atthadhammaniruttīsu paṭibhāne tath' eva ca / ñāṇaṃ amhaṃ mahāvīra uppannaṃ tava santike // //
thi-ap30:20.1: Pubbānaṃ lokanāthānaṃ saṅgamaṃ no nidassitaṃ / adhikārā bahū amhe tuyh' atthāya mahāmune. // //
thi-ap30:21.1: Yaṃ amhaṃ purimaṃ kammaṃ kusalaṃ sarase mune / tuyh' atthāya mahāvīra puññāni pacitāni no. // //
thi-ap30:22.1: Abhabbaṭṭhāne vajjetvā pācayimha anāvaraṃ / tuyh' atthāya mahāvīra cattāni jīvitāni no. // //
thi-ap30:23.1: Nekakoṭisahassāni bhariyatthāya dāsi no / na tattha vimanā homa tuyh' atthāya mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap30:24.1: Nekakoṭisahassāni upakārāya dāsi no / na tattha vimanā homa tuyh' atthāya mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap30:25.1: Nekakoṭisahassāni bhojanatthāya dāsi no / na tattha vimanā homa tuyh' atthāya mahāmune. // //
thi-ap30:26.1: Nekakoṭisahassāni jīvitāni cajimha no. / bhayamokkhaṃ karissāma jīvitāni cajimha no. // //
thi-ap30:27.1: Aṅgagate alaṅkāre vatthe nānāvidhe bahū / itthibhaṇḍena gūhāma tuyh' atthāya mahāmune. // //
thi-ap30:28.1: Dhanadhaññapariccāgaṃ gāmāni nigamāni ca / khettaṃ dhītañ ca puttañ ca pariccattaṃ mahāmuni. // //
thi-ap30:29.1: Hatthi-assa-gavañ cāpi dāsiyo paricārikā / tuyhatthāya mahāvīra pariccattaṃ asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:30.1: Yaṃ amhe paṭimantesi dānaṃ dassāma yācake / vimanaṃ no na passāma dadato dānaṃ uttamaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:31.1: Nānāvidhaṃ bahuṃ dukkhaṃ saṃsāre ca bahubbidhe / tuyhatthāya mahāvīra pariccattaṃ asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:32.1: Sukhaṃ patvā na modāma na ca dukkhesu dummanā / sabbatthā tulitā homa tuyhatthāya mahāmune. // //
thi-ap30:33.1: Anumaggena sambuddho saddhammaṃ abhinīharī / anubhotvā sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ patto bodhiṃ mahāmuni // //
thi-ap30:34.1: Brahmadevañ ca sambuddhaṃ Gotamaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / aññesaṃ lokanāthānaṃ saṅgaman te hi no bahuṃ. // //
thi-ap30:35.1: Adhikāraṃ bahuṃ amhe tuyhatthāya mahāmuni / gavesantā Buddhadhammaṃ mayan te paricārikā. // //
thi-ap30:36.1: Kappe ca satasahasse ca caturo ca asaṅkhiye / Dīpaṅkaro mahāvīro uppajji lokanāyako. // //
thi-ap30:37.1: Paccanta-desa-visaye nimantetvā Tathāgataṃ / tassa āgamanaṃ maggaṃ sodhenti tuṭṭhamānasā. // //
thi-ap30:38.1: Tena kālena so āsi Sumedho nāma brāhmaṇo / maggañ ca paṭiyādesi āyato sabbadassino. // //
thi-ap30:39.1: Tena kālena āsimhā sabbā brāhmaṇasambhavā / phaludakajātipupphāni āharimha samāgamaṃ // //
thi-ap30:40.1: Tasmiṃ so samaye Buddho Dīpaṅkaro mahāyaso / viyākāsi mahāvīro isim uggata-mānasaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:41.1: Calati ravati puthavī saṅkampati sadevake / tassa kammaṃ pakittento isim uggata-mānasaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:42.1: Devakaññā manussā ca amhe cāpi sadevakā / nānāpūjanīyaṃ bhaṇḍam pūjayitvāna patthayuṃ. // //
thi-ap30:43.1: Tesaṃ Buddho viyākāsi jotidīpī-sanāmako: / ajjā ye patthitā atthi te bhavissanti sammukhā. // //
thi-ap30:44.1: Aparimeyy' ito kappe yaṃ no Buddho viyākari / vācaṃ anumodantā evakārī ahumha no. // //
thi-ap30:45.1: Tassa kammassa sukatassa tattha cittaṃ pasādayuṃ / devamānusakaṃ yoniṃ anubhotvā asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:46.1: Sukhadukkhe 'nubhotvāna devesu mānusesu ca / pacchime bhavasampatte ajātā Sākiye kule. // //
thi-ap30:47.1: Rūpavatī bhogavatī yasa-sīlavatī *tato / sabbaṅgasampadā* homa kulesu atisakkatā. // //
thi-ap30:48.1: Lābhaṃ silokaṃ sakkāraṃ lokadhammasamāgamaṃ / cittañ ca dukkhitaṃ n' atthi vasāma akutobhayaṃ. // //
thi-ap30:49.1: Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā rañño antepure tadā / khattiyānaṃ pure vīra upakāratthañ ca niddisī. // //
thi-ap30:50.1: Upakārā ca yā nārī yā ca nārī sukhe dukhe / atthakkhāyī ca yā nārī yā narī cānukampikā. // //
thi-ap30:51.1: Dhammaṃ care sucaritaṃ na naṃ duccaritaṃ care / dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti asmiṃ loke paramhi ca. // //
thi-ap30:52.1: Agāraṃ vijahitvāna pabbajimhā 'nagāriyaṃ / aṭṭhamāse asampatte catusaccaṃ phusimhi no. // //
thi-ap30:53.1: Cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ / upanenti bahuṃ amhe sāgarass' eva ūmiyo.
thi-ap30:57.1: *Evaṃ* bahuvidhaṃ dukkhaṃ sampattī ca bahubbidhā / visuddhabhāvasampattā labhāma sabbasampadā. // //
thi-ap30:58.1: Yā dadanti sakattānaṃ puññatthāya mahesino / pabhāyasampadā bhonti nibbān'-amat'-asaṅkhataṃ // //
thi-ap30:59.1: Parikkhīṇaṃ atītañ ca paccuppannaṃ anāgataṃ / saccaṃ kammam pi no khīṇaṃ pāde vandāmi cakkhumā // //
thi-ap30:60.1: Nibbānāya vadantīnaṃ kiñ ca vakkhāmi uttariṃ / santasaṃkhatadoso yo pappotha amataṃ padan
thi-ap30:61.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ Yasodharā pamukhāni aṭṭhārasabhikkhunī sahassā*ni*imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Uddānaṃ:
thi-ap30:65.1: Kuṇḍalā-Gotamī c' eva Dhammadinnā ca Sākulā Varanandā c' eva Sonā ca {Kāpilānī} Yasodharā.
thi-ap30:66.1: Dasaṭṭhārasasahassā gāthāyo gaṇitā-v-iha satāni c' eva cattāri aṭṭhasattatim eva ca.
